title: Larry S. Kacher
vital_facts: Born February 12, 1952; grew up in Bloomington, Minn.
Baptized 1971; Aaronic Priesthood shortly thereafter; Melchizedek Priesthood 1973.
Full-time Missionary to Tahiti Papeete Mission 1973 - 1975
Married Pauline Miller, Manti Utah Temple, October 29, 1976; six children
Bachelor's in psychology; Master's in Organizational Behavior; both from BYU
Self employed, national and international consultant.
Elders Quorum President, Branch President, Bishop and Counselor to Stake President.
First Area Seventy assigned to Middle East.
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
